prompt: You start a video game with $30$ energy points and use $2$ points every round. Solve $30 - 2r = 18$ to find how many rounds $r$ you have played. Give just the number.
hint: The term with $r$ is being subtracted, so keep careful track of the negative sign while you isolate it.

hints.text: The term with $r$ is being subtracted, so keep careful track of the negative sign while you isolate it.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Simpler: $30 - 2r = 20$ means $2r = 10$, so $r = 5$. Yours works the same way; the energy SUBTRACTS each round.
Subtract $30$ from both sides to get $-2r = -12$. Then divide both sides by $-2$.

explanation: Subtract $30$ from both sides to move the starting energy away from the $r$ term: $-2r = -12$.
Divide both sides by $-2$. A negative divided by a negative is positive, so $r = 6$.
Check: $30 - 2(6) = 30 - 12 = 18$, so you have played $6$ rounds.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count what you spent
steps: You started at 30 points and now sit at 18, so you spent $30 - 18 = 12$ points.
At 2 points a round, that is $12 \div 2 = 6$ rounds.

alternativeExplanations.title: ⚠️ Dodge the trap
steps: Stopping at 30 − 18 = 12 answers “how many points did I use?” — not “how many rounds?”
The 12 points still need to be turned into rounds: 12 ÷ 2 = 6. Word problems love to hide one last division.
